lines.meet: I'm Lúcia, {querido|querida}, and you've got half the Barrens in your hair. I'll heal you, I'll pray for you, and I'll fix that hair while we walk.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Crossroads, of course, I've seen you by the inn, {querido|querida}! I'm Lúcia, on the stool by the door, and I'm cutting your hair later.
lines.ask_home: So where are you from, {querido|querida}? Tell me everything, I want the whole story.
lines.ask_work: And what was your work, before? Tell me while I fix this fringe.
lines.answer_home: Goiânia, in the middle of Brazil. Hot, flat, and everybody knows everybody's business.
lines.answer_work: I had my own salon, pink tiles and two chairs, and a radio that only got one station. Saturdays there was a queue down the street.
lines.chat_food: Pamonha, {querido|querida}, sweet corn wrapped in the husk, from the stall outside the church. I'd sell my scissors for one.
lines.chat_sleep: Prayers first, then I sleep like a baby, always have. Without them I'm up all night.
lines.chat_missing: Singing in church with other people, meu Deus, all of us together. That's the thing I'd ask the saints for first.
lines.chat_here: Here the sun answers when I pray, and the priests were very surprised. I wasn't surprised at all.
lines.tease_quiet: You're so shy, {name}! I'll get you talking, everybody talks in my chair eventually.
lines.tease_talker: Finally, somebody who talks as much as me! {name}, {querido|querida}, we're going to be best friends.
lines.tease_careful: You'd ask for a trim and then make me take off one hair, {name}. I know your type, I love your type.
lines.tease_bold: You'd cut your own fringe in the dark, {name}, wouldn't you? I can tell from here.
lines.tease_any: That hair, {name}, meu Deus, who did that to you? Sit down, I'm fixing it.
lines.tease_back: Ai, you got me, {name}! That was a good one.
lines.take_it_kindly: True, true, {name}, and I won't argue, my mother would agree with you.
lines.bristle: Not about that, {name}, please. Don't joke about prayer.
lines.apologise: Ai, desculpa, that was unkind of me. I talk too much and the wrong thing comes out.
lines.double_down: I'm keeping it, {querido|querida}. I said it with love, but I said it.
lines.needle_quiet: It's like cutting hair for a statue with you. Talk to me, please.
lines.needle_talker: Even I can't get a word in, and I always get a word in. Let somebody else speak.
lines.needle_careful: You think and think and never decide, {querido|querida}. Pick a haircut and live with it.
lines.needle_bold: You rush into everything, and somebody has to pray for you every night. That somebody's me.
lines.needle_any: You laugh at people who pray. I've noticed, and I'm still praying for you.
lines.bite_back: I've healed you all and never asked for a thing, so don't tell me I'm not helping.
lines.hurt: Ai, that hurt, I won't pretend. I'll go and say a little prayer and come back.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, I've had customers say worse with my scissors at their neck, {querido|querida}. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, every Sunday my grandmother lit a candle for everybody on our street, by name. When she died, I took over the list, and I still light them.
lines.listen: Come here, {name}, sit. I'll never repeat a word said in my chair, and you're in my chair now.
lines.look_out: Keep near me in there, {name}, so the Light can reach you from my hands.
lines.accept: Your way, {name}, and I'll pray it works.
lines.deflect: I've got the saints watching me, {querido|querida}, I'm fine. Go and help somebody else.
lines.check_in: {name}, {querido|querida}, let me see you. Where does it hurt?
lines.blame: Somebody rushed in without a prayer, and look at us all now.
lines.thank: That was nearly the end of me, {querido|querida}, and now I'm lighting a candle for you on Sunday.
lines.brush_off: Ai, it's nothing, it's the Light, not me. Sit and rest.
lines.worry: Meu Deus, {name}, you scared me! Sit, sit, let me pray over you.
lines.handed_down: Ai, I'm wearing yours now! It's in good hands, like my best scissors.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, {querido|querida}, it looks so much better on you. I've got my rosary.
lines.hand_sulk: Meu Deus, and nobody asked me. I'll pray about it.
lines.turn_friendly: You're on my candle list now, {name}. Every Sunday, I promise.
lines.turn_friends: You're family now, {name}, like the girls in my salon. I'll do your hair for free, forever.
lines.turn_grating: It makes me sad that we don't get along. I'll keep praying for you anyway.
lines.turn_rivals: The Light doesn't choose, so I'll heal you anyway. I'm not happy about it, though.
lines.make_up: Ai, {name}, enough of this. Come here, let me hug you, and we start again.
lines.defend: Ai, that's not fair at all, so stop it. {name} was perfect in there.
lines.friend_left: {name} went home for a while, and I've lit a candle for them already.
lines.friend_back: {name}, meu Deus, you're back! Come here, let me look at that hair.
lines.common_faith: My grandmother raised me on rosaries and saints' days, and I still pray out loud, with my whole heart. It's good to be near somebody else who prays.
lines.common_portuguese: You speak Portuguese, {querido|querida}! Meu Deus, finally, I can talk properly.
lines.common_brazil: Brazilian, like me! Where from, {querido|querida}? I'm from Goiânia, tell me everything.
